blocks.content: Quiz: What is the primary purpose of the counting list in counting sort?
Tap an option below to answer:
The counting list doesn't contain the items of the original list but their frequency of occurrence within the list.
The counting list doesn't contain the items of the original list but their frequency of occurrence within the list.
The counting list doesn't replace the original list. It's a new list with the frequency of occurrence of items in the original list.
The counting list doesn't replace the original list. It's a new list with the frequency of occurrence of items in the original list.
To store the maximum element of the list.
The counting list doesn't just store the maximum element. It stores all the elements starting from 0 to the maximum element; it has a size of max + 1.
The counting list doesn't just store the maximum element. It stores all the elements starting from 0 to the maximum element; it has a size of max + 1.
To record the occurrence of each element in the original list.
The counting list is used to keep track of the occurrence of each element from the original list.
The counting list is used to keep track of the occurrence of each element from the original list.
